name: laronge-folder-logbook
description: Folder Logbook for Claude, a free plugin by Josh Laronge (laronge.com).

plugins.name: laronge-folder-logbook
plugins.description: Keeps a record of your work with Claude as Markdown files in a folder you pick: a Start Here map, a dashboard per project, one file per chat with your prompts and Claude's responses, and an activity log.
